title: Built-in Types — Common Sequence Operations
why: Primary definition of stepped slices and their exclusive stop for either step sign.

claim: A stepped slice selects i+n*k with 0 <= n < (j-i)/k, excluding the stop; positive steps stay below it and negative steps above it.
quote: The slice of s from i to j with step k is defined as the sequence of items with index x = i + n*k such that 0 <= n < (j-i)/k.

title: torch.nn.Linear
why: Primary example of a model layer applying an additive bias vector to input samples.

claim: PyTorch Linear applies an affine transformation with an additive bias, y = xA^T + b.
quote: Applies an affine linear transformation to the incoming data: y = xA^(T) + b.
